title: Your First Tour at Ocean Canyon

blocks.headline: Ninety minutes. One resort. No pressure.
lines: A guided drive through the resort
blocks.narration: Your first tour is a ninety minute guided drive through one resort. Ask anything you want.

blocks.headline: Running late? Just call.
lines: We hold your spot for thirty minutes
blocks.narration: Running late? Just call the number in your text. We hold your spot for thirty minutes.

blocks.headline: See you at the welcome center
lines: Your gift is yours either way
blocks.narration: Reply yes to confirm, and we'll see you at the welcome center. Your gift is yours either way.
